bagPolicy.summary: SNHU Arena enforces a clear bag policy allowing clear totes up to 9" x 12" x 4" and wristlets up to 4" x 6" x 1". Purses and backpacks are not permitted.
allowed: clear tote not to exceed 9" x 12" x 4"
wristlets not to exceed 4" x 6" x 1"
bagPolicy.note: Limited exceptions for medical or diaper bags will be allowed.

parking.note: Parking for SNHU Arena events is available at all city meters, parking garages, and parking lots. SNHU Arena does not manage or have parking on site, and is not responsible for parking costs or location. Accessible parking is available on Harry Theo Lane.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in SNHU Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: SNHU Arena offers a premium experience with options like the VIP Club and Sam Adams Lounge, which provide full bar and snack service. These areas offer comfortable seating and a modern atmosphere for VIP guests.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: For accessible seating options, please contact Ticketmaster at ticketmaster.com or 1-800-653-8000. The Accessible Parking lot is located on Harry Theo Lane.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exiting and re-entering the building with the same ticket is not permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at SNHU Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at SNHU Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
